# EmDash CMS

> An open-source Astro CMS with an admin for people and content APIs for authorized agents.

## Start here

- [Build a site with EmDash](https://emdashcms.com/start.md): A short handoff for coding agents, from the user's brief to an editable local site.
- [Create your first site](https://docs.emdashcms.com/getting-started/): Scaffold a new Astro and EmDash site.
- [Add EmDash to an Astro project](https://docs.emdashcms.com/existing-project/): Keep an existing site and add the CMS.

## Work with agents

- [Connect AI tools to a site](https://docs.emdashcms.com/guides/ai-tools/): Authenticated MCP access to content after setup.
- [EmDash docs MCP](https://docs.emdashcms.com/docs-mcp/): Read-only search over current documentation.

## Reference

- [Complete documentation index](https://docs.emdashcms.com/llms.txt): Guides and API references.
- [CLI reference](https://docs.emdashcms.com/reference/cli/): Local setup and content commands.
